searchText: > Peers that are unable to reply to data column sidecar requests within the range data_column_serve_range **SHOULD respond with error code 3: ResourceUnavailable**. I wonder how other clients team handle this case? grandine respond empty in this case wouldn't `empty` response be incorrect? as empty could mean that there was no data columns that's make sense, so I have to handle this kind of case with this rpc error, and handle the response with the status code, instead of downscore and disconnect we have it in byRange, but I don't see it in byRoot Double checked Teku byRange: it returns sorted response (by slot + columns index) even if `column_indexes` are not sorted in request. May be you could log the exact request/response from Teku? okay thanks for checking
